changelog:
Discord presence handles pausing properly now: while an episode plays you get the live progress bar, and the moment you pause, the bar is replaced by the elapsed time at the paused position — no progress bar keeps creeping forward while nothing is playing.
Resuming re-anchors the bar to the real playback position instead of continuing from where the paused timer had drifted, and an item without a known duration keeps the plain elapsed timer while it plays.
The option's description in Discord settings now states both halves of that behaviour.
Every button this module adds to the player row is reachable with a TV remote or gamepad again: they were clickable but not focusable, so a D-pad could never land on them. They now take remote focus, show a clear focused highlight, and the row's focus order leads from CloudStream's own last button into these actions and back out.
Those buttons also match the size of CloudStream's own row buttons instead of a fixed larger square — box, icon size and spacing are copied from the real button next to them (phone and TV layouts both), and on TV the icons are drawn at the host's smaller icon size instead of oversized.
message: Dev build v867 - paused presence plus host-sized, remote-reachable player buttons
